subject: E-3381: totals mismatch on Android
body:
Good morning. My setup is MeshMail 2.8.1, Android 14 (Galaxy S23). Whenever I open the summary since Tuesday, the app shows "E-3381: totals do not match source".

A time-zone change on the laptop shifted the daily totals. Entries close to midnight show up under the neighbouring day.

Before writing in I tried rebooting the router; same error afterwards.

Luca Moretti - Northbank Studio. Appreciate any pointers.
